info.title: Tide Cloud REST API
info.description: Complete REST API specification for Tide Cloud backend services supporting End-to-End Encryption (E2EE), CRDT document synchronization, file storage, todos, personal access tokens, real-time messaging, user profiles, and Server-Sent Events (SSE).

servers.description: Tide Cloud API v1 Base Path

bearerAuth.description: JSON Web Token (JWT) user session passed in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

patAuth.name: X-API-Key
patAuth.description: Personal Access Token (`tide_pat_...`) passed in the `X-API-Key` header or `Authorization: Bearer tide_pat_...`.

public_key.description: User public encryption key (base64 or hex encoded)

pin.description: User security PIN to be hashed via Argon2id

refresh_token.description: Refresh token for issuing new JWTs

encrypted_dek.description: Encrypted Data Encryption Key for the file

id.description: Optional client-generated UUID for the file

encrypted_dek.description: E2EE Data Encryption Key encrypted with user's key

initial_payload.description: Optional base64 encoded initial encrypted payload or CRDT state

encrypted_dek_for_user.description: File DEK encrypted with recipient's public key

snapshot.description: Base64-encoded encrypted compacted snapshot if available

description.example: Check unit test coverage and API schemas
Finalize and test all REST schemas

token.description: Full secret token. Displayed only once.

bio.example: Software engineer and open source contributor

post.description: Registers a new user account with client-generated public keys, encrypted vault, pepper, and Argon2id hashed PIN.

400.description: Missing required fields or invalid format

post.description: Initiates sign-in or verification by dispatching a 6-digit OTP code to the provided email address.

post.summary: Verify OTP and obtain session tokens
post.description: Validates the one-time password code along with optional user PIN, returning session JWT and vault tokens.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a refreshed JWT access token.

get.description: Retrieves metadata for all accessible files owned by or shared with the authenticated user.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Filter files by parent folder UUID

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by file type (e.g., note, folder)

post.description: Creates a new file record with associated E2EE DEK metadata.

get.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific file by its UUID.

patch.description: Updates file properties such as title, parent directory, or trash status.

delete.description: Deletes or moves a file to trash.

403.description: Forbidden - Only file owner or admin can delete

get.description: Retrieves the list of active shares and access permissions for the specified file.

403.description: Forbidden - Must be owner or have share management rights

post.description: Grants read or write access to another user for this file.

get.description: Retrieves the current Yjs state vector and latest updates/snapshot for offline merging.

404.description: File or CRDT state not found

post.description: Merges incremental Yjs binary delta updates in SQLite/WAL into a single compacted snapshot to optimize storage and sync latency.

get.description: Lists todos with filtering by status, priority, tags, or file association. Supports PAT scopes `todos:read` and `todos:write`.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Filter by priority level (low, medium, high, urgent)

post.description: Creates a new todo item. Requires scope `todos:create` or `todos:write`.

patch.description: Partially updates a todo item (status, text, due date, tags). Requires scope `todos:edit` or `todos:write`.

delete.description: Deletes a todo item. Requires scope `todos:delete` or `todos:write`.

get.description: Retrieves all personal access tokens issued by the authenticated user.

post.description: Generates a new Personal Access Token (`tide_pat_...`) with defined permission scopes.

201.description: API token created. Contains raw secret token only in this response.

delete.description: Deletes and revokes a Personal Access Token by its UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the token to revoke

get.description: Retrieves encrypted messages for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by conversation partner.

post.description: Sends an end-to-end encrypted message to another user.

get.description: Lists all accepted and pending contacts for the current user.

post.description: Sends a new contact request to another user by their user ID.

get.description: Retrieves the profile of the current authenticated user or public profile search.

put.description: Updates the profile attributes (display name, bio, avatar) for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Subscribe to real-time events via Server-Sent Events (SSE)
get.description: Establishes a long-lived text/event-stream connection to receive real-time notifications for file changes, message alerts, contact requests, and presence updates.

401.description: Unauthorized - Valid JWT required to subscribe to stream
